review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description Join Intelligent Technical Solutions, a dynamic and growing company, as our Network Administrator. You'll handle a range of tasks, from system updates to hands-on troubleshooting, playing a critical role in maintaining our high standards of IT service. Job Responsibilities This role is expected to be able to resolve the following technical issues with little or no assistance: Workstation operating system issues of any kind. M365 administration issues of any kind. Job Qualificatio
eligibility_evidence: Escalation point for technicians Participate in an on-call rotation to provide after-hours and weekend support for onsite and remote operations.
Able to provide NBI Clearance (for PH applicants).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You'll handle a range of tasks, from system updates to hands-on troubleshooting, playing a critical role in maintaining our high standards of IT service. Job Qualifications Experience with Windows and Mac OS troubleshooting. Proficient in Microsoft Entra Admin Center. Proficient in Firewall rules, VLAN configuration, access point support and administration, and VPN tunnels. Minimum of five years experience in IT Support or a similar role. Job Requirements A home office set up that meets the following: Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following: Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or macOS 12 or newer.
